projectDescription: SpaceXAI's terminal-based AI coding agent — a fullscreen, mouse-interactive TUI that understands codebases, edits files, runs shell commands, searches the web, and can be extended with plugins, hooks, and MCP servers.
keyFeatures: Full-screen interactive TUI with vim mode, mouse support, and configurable themes
Fullscreen and minimal render modes, sticky across sessions
Browser login, API key, OIDC/SSO, and external auth provider support
Built-in tools: file editing, grep, shell execution, web search/fetch, subagent spawning, memory search
MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integration for external tool extensions
Skills system — reusable SKILL.md prompt packages, auto-invoked or slash-command triggered
Plugin marketplace — bundles of skills, hooks, MCP servers, and agents installable from GitHub
Lifecycle hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionStart, Stop, etc.) for automation and safety
Agent Client Protocol (ACP) JSON-RPC server for IDE and SDK integration
Subagents for parallel task delegation with isolated context windows
Plan mode for structured planning before code edits
OS-level sandbox isolation via Landlock (Linux) and Seatbelt (macOS)
Cross-session memory with FTS5 + vector hybrid search
Headless mode with JSON and streaming-JSON output for CI/CD automation
OpenTelemetry export for fleet-wide usage monitoring
publicApiSurface: grok plugin validate / grok plugin tag
grok agent stdio / grok agent serve
